notes.title: Valley Egg is now online-enabled!
notes.content: Starting with version 0.5.5, Volley Egg can now be played online.

notes.title: Online co-op mode now supported!
notes.content:
Version 0.5.0 now available!

Supports up to 4 devices for online co-op play.
Compatible with the previous offline co-op mode (1 device connected to 4 controllers), allowing multiple players to participate on 1 device.

notes.title: Version 0.4.8 has been released!
notes.content:
Version 0.4.8 has been released!

Fixes
・Added a feature to connect players with rubber bands.
・Overall performance improvements.

notes.title: Version 0.4.3 is now available!
notes.content:
Version 0.4.3 is now available!

No new features this time, but an important update for future enhancements!
Also, the behavior of Two Hands Eggs has been made snappier!

notes.title: Mechanism functions are now available!
notes.content:
With the update of version 0.4.0, the mechanism function is now available!

This function allows you to create various gimmicks such as moving scaffolds, pitfalls, and urchins that suddenly appear!
